questions.question: When the Canaanite king of Arad attacked Israel in the Negev, what did he take from them?
After being attacked by a Canaanite king, Israel made a vow to the LORD. What did they ask Him to do?

answers.text: Hand their attackers over to them
Give them a safe road through the land
Lead them far away from the Negev

questions.question: After Israel defeated the Canaanites of Arad, what name did they give the place?
